name: The Hillside Retreat
headline:
Wake up
to something more.
intro: Fresh mountain air, expansive views, and space to settle into your own rhythm. A light-filled retreat above the rooftops of Brașov.
storyTitle:
Life looks good
from up here.
story: Set against a green hillside, this contemporary home frames the landscape from almost every room. The seasons become part of the interior, from summer greens to snow-covered roofs.
An open-plan ground floor flows onto a generous terrace. Upstairs, quiet bedrooms offer a welcome retreat after a day spent exploring the mountains or the city below.

images.alt: Light-filled contemporary home with natural finishes
images.caption: A little space above it all.

images.alt: Airy living room with large windows
images.caption: Let the outside in.

images.alt: Comfortable living space with a generous seating area
images.caption: Stay a little longer.

locationDescription: The winding streets of Șchei lead from forest trails to the historic heart of Brașov. An ideal base for people who feel most at home with a little adventure nearby.
